title: User Registration and Account Creation
description: Verify that a new user can successfully register and create an account.
testDescription: A new user provides valid information to register an account.
prerequisites: No existing account with the provided email.
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to the registration page.
2. Enter valid email, password, and personal details.
3. Agree to terms and conditions.
4. Click 'Register' button.
expectedResult: User receives a confirmation email and is redirected to the welcome page.
additionalFields: Data Privacy Compliance: Ensure PII is encrypted, Email Format: Valid email format required

title: Product Search and Filtering
description: Verify that users can search and filter products effectively.
testDescription: A user searches for a product and applies filters to narrow down results.
prerequisites: Product catalog must be populated with various items.
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to the search bar.
2. Enter a product keyword.
3. Apply filters such as category, price range, and brand.
4. Click 'Search' button.
expectedResult: Search results are displayed according to the applied filters.
additionalFields: Boundary Value Analysis: Test with minimum and maximum price filters, Search Performance: Results should load within 2 seconds

title: Checkout Process including Payment Gateway Integration
description: Verify the checkout process and payment gateway integration.
testDescription: A user completes a purchase using a valid payment method.
prerequisites: User must have items in the shopping cart.
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to the shopping cart.
2. Click 'Proceed to Checkout'.
3. Enter shipping details.
4. Select a payment method and enter payment details.
5. Confirm the order.
expectedResult: Order is processed successfully and payment is confirmed.
additionalFields: Payment Gateway Integration: Ensure secure transaction, Error Handling: Proper error message on payment failure

title: Order Confirmation and Email Notifications
description: Verify that users receive order confirmation and email notifications.
testDescription: A user receives an order confirmation email after a successful purchase.
stepsToPerform:
1. Complete a purchase.
2. Check the registered email for confirmation.
3. Verify the order details in the email.
expectedResult: Order confirmation email is received with correct order details.
additionalFields: Email Format: Ensure email is well-formatted, Data Integrity: Order details match the purchase

title: Role-based Access Control
description: Verify that users have appropriate access based on their roles.
testDescription: Different user roles have access to specific functionalities.
prerequisites: Users with different roles exist in the system.
stepsToPerform:
1. Log in as an admin user.
2. Access admin dashboard.
3. Log out and log in as a regular user.
4. Attempt to access admin dashboard.
expectedResult: Admin user can access admin dashboard, regular user cannot.
additionalFields: Decision Table Testing: Validate access permissions for each role, Security Compliance: Ensure unauthorized access is blocked

title: Shopping Cart Management
description: Verify that users can add, update, and remove items from the shopping cart.
testDescription: A user manages items in their shopping cart.
prerequisites: User must be logged in and browsing products.
stepsToPerform:
1. Add a product to the cart.
2. Update the quantity of the product.
3. Remove the product from the cart.
expectedResult: Items are added, updated, and removed successfully with cart total updated accordingly.
additionalFields: Data Integrity: Ensure cart updates reflect in the database, User Feedback: Provide confirmation messages for actions

title: User Profile Management
description: Verify that users can update their profile information.
testDescription: A user updates their personal information in the profile.
prerequisites: User must have an existing account and be logged in.
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to the profile page.
2. Update personal details such as name and address.
3. Save changes.
expectedResult: Profile information is updated successfully and changes are reflected immediately.
additionalFields: Data Privacy: Ensure PII is encrypted, Data Refresh: Verify data is not overwritten incorrectly

title: Data Privacy and Security Compliance
description: Verify compliance with data privacy regulations.
testDescription: Ensure user data is handled according to privacy standards.
prerequisites: System must be configured with privacy compliance settings.
stepsToPerform:
1. Register a new user.
2. Access user data through profile settings.
3. Attempt unauthorized access to another user's data.
expectedResult: User data is protected and unauthorized access is blocked.
additionalFields: Compliance Standards: GDPR, CCPA, Data Encryption: Ensure all sensitive data is encrypted

title: Error Handling and User Feedback Mechanisms
description: Verify that the system provides appropriate error messages and feedback.
testDescription: A user encounters an error during checkout.
prerequisites: User must have items in the cart and be proceeding to checkout.
stepsToPerform:
1. Proceed to checkout with invalid payment details.
2. Observe the error message displayed.
expectedResult: User receives a clear and informative error message with guidance on how to resolve the issue.
additionalFields: Error Messaging: Ensure messages are user-friendly, Rollback Mechanisms: Verify no partial transactions occur

title: Integration with External Systems
description: Verify integration with external payment gateways and shipping services.
testDescription: Ensure seamless interaction with external systems during checkout.
prerequisites: System must be configured with external service integrations.
stepsToPerform:
1. Add items to the cart.
2. Proceed to checkout.
3. Select a shipping method and payment gateway.
4. Complete the transaction.
expectedResult: Transaction is completed successfully with correct interaction with external systems.
additionalFields: Integration Points: Payment Gateway, Shipping Service, Transaction Logs: Ensure logs capture all interactions

title: Boundary Value Analysis for Discounts
description: Verify that discount calculations are accurate at boundary values.
testDescription: A user applies a discount code at the boundary values of discount eligibility.
prerequisites: User must have items in the cart that qualify for discounts.
stepsToPerform:
1. Add items to the cart with a total just below the discount threshold.
2. Apply discount code.
3. Increase cart total to meet the discount threshold.
4. Apply discount code again.
expectedResult: Discount is not applied when below threshold, and applied correctly when threshold is met.
additionalFields: Boundary Values: Test just below and at the discount threshold, Discount Calculation: Ensure correct discount percentage is applied

title: State Transition Testing for Order Status
description: Verify correct state transitions for order processing.
testDescription: An order transitions through various states from processing to delivery.
prerequisites: User must have completed a purchase.
stepsToPerform:
1. Place an order.
2. Verify order status is 'Processing'.
3. Update order status to 'Shipped'.
4. Update order status to 'Delivered'.
expectedResult: Order status updates correctly at each stage with appropriate notifications sent.
additionalFields: State Transitions: Processing, Shipped, Delivered, Notifications: Ensure user receives updates at each stage

title: Data Integrity Checks for Transaction Records
description: Ensure transaction records are accurate and consistent.
testDescription: Verify that transaction records are correctly logged and stored.
prerequisites: User must have completed a transaction.
stepsToPerform:
1. Complete a purchase.
2. Access transaction history in user profile.
3. Verify transaction details match the purchase.
expectedResult: Transaction records are accurate and consistent with purchase details.
additionalFields: Data Integrity: Ensure no discrepancies in transaction logs, Record Consistency: Verify all fields are correctly populated

title: Validation of Data Refresh During Profile Updates
description: Verify that profile updates are correctly saved and reflected.
testDescription: A user updates their profile information and verifies changes.
prerequisites: User must have an existing account and be logged in.
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to the profile page.
2. Update personal details such as phone number and address.
3. Save changes and refresh the page.
4. Verify updated information is displayed.
expectedResult: Profile updates are saved and displayed correctly after refresh.
additionalFields: Data Refresh: Ensure no data loss or incorrect overwrites, User Feedback: Confirmation message on successful update

title: Handling Payment Processing Failures
description: Verify system behavior when payment processing fails.
testDescription: A user encounters a payment failure during checkout.
prerequisites: User must have items in the cart and be proceeding to checkout.
stepsToPerform:
1. Proceed to checkout.
2. Enter invalid payment details.
3. Attempt to complete the purchase.
4. Observe system response.
expectedResult: User receives a clear error message and the transaction is rolled back.
additionalFields: Error Handling: Ensure informative error messages, Rollback Mechanisms: Verify no partial transactions occur
